notes.title: Hot summer update that let you burn some disks!
notes.notes: [p][b]Update KP010800: Improvements and fixes[/b][/p][p]This update includes various improvements. Key changes include:[/p][p]- Provides a new bonus mini-game: Disk Burning[/p][p]- Provides a new level element: Block+Chain[/p][p]- Provides a new level element: Non Functional Thing[/p][p]- Provides a new level element: Chained coin[/p][p]- Provides a new accessibility feature: Desaturated background for better contrast[/p][p]- Provides new websites for the Progressnet[/p][p]- Provides bug fixing and tuning[/p]

notes.title: The May update brings graphics cards and new modes for the Decompiler gun
notes.notes:
Update KP009900: Improvements and fixes.

- Provides a some UI/UX improvements for IDLE network

notes.title: The January update presents: B OS system
notes.notes:
[b]Update KP009800: Improvements and fixes.[/b]

This update includes various improvements. Key changes include:

- Provides a special system: [b]B OS[/b] (it may work both on Progress computer and Progresh)
- Provides a new design for the post-game bonus screen, it can passed much faster now
- Provides a couple of new websites for the Progressnet
- Provides a little delay before the game over screen to demonstrate a hit by the red segment 
- Provides a fix for the situation where an installed gamepad may activate on-screen keyboard in ProgressDOS/Terminus
- Provides some optimizations for the asset folder, the installation size has to be less

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38605237/2df6264282f05e1201f4b35ee681812fc47b0459.png[/img]

notes.title: February Update presents Bar OS 8
notes.notes:
Update KP007200: Improvements and fixes.

This update includes various improvements. Key changes include:

- Provides a new skin: BarOS 8
- Provides a new game mode: Progressbar XL a numeric maze.
- Provides Progressbar Commander for PB95, 95 plus and 98
- Provides a support for a larger list of mods
- Provides a support for custom audio intros/outros for mods (just place your intro.mp3 or outro.mp3 file in the mod's folder)

Enjoy the new update!

notes.title: The November Update introduces BarOS
notes.notes:
Update KP006610: Improvements and fixes.

This update includes various improvements. Key changes include:

- Provides an alternative line of systems: BarOS and Progresh computers
- Provides new skins: BarOS,BarOS Sys 2 and BarOS Sys 3
- Provides new game mechanics for basic game modes (only for BarOS)
- Provides a file manager (only for BarOS)
- Provides new bonuses: Magic Pink and Outer space
- Addresses an issue that makes Progresstein 3d to flicker
- Addresses an issue that causes startup glitches when Enter button is pressed to often
- Addresses an issue that might freezes the game when Challenges windows appears
- Addresses an issue that might freezes the game after Scan Progress is complete

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38605237/b23743a78d78e9f339534c6e2a8c637d99e1cf8d.png[/img]
